first.rationale: Activation has the largest current decline, and in-product messaging can address it without the margin and customer-quality risks of reacting immediately with discounts. Verify the activation evidence and the promotional-pricing alternative before committing, with qualified revenue and retention as downstream guardrails.

final.rationale: Run activation messaging because the verified source showed +6% activation, +11% week-one engagement, and +1% 30-day retention, directly addressing the current activation decline while supporting sustainable revenue. Do not choose promotional pricing: despite +18% qualified revenue initially, its cohort suffered a verified 12% retention decline and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Measure activation as the leading outcome and retention and qualified revenue as downstream guardrails.
